# Review Sentiment for an Invoicing App

What do customers of an invoicing app complain about, how has that changed over ten years, and which releases did they like least?

**Notebook:** [review_sentiment.ipynb](review_sentiment.ipynb) · **Data:** synthetic, generated by [make_data.py](make_data.py)

## Data

9,777 reviews of an invoicing app for small businesses from the App Store, Google Play and Trustpilot, October 2016 to November 2026 (`reviews.csv`), and 250 app releases with their dates and contents (`releases.csv`).

## Approach

1. Removed older copies of edited reviews and set aside a batch of Trustpilot reviews whose dates are import dates.
2. Used the stars as labels (4 and 5 positive, 1 and 2 negative) and trained a TF-IDF and linear SVM model on single words and word pairs.
3. Tested it twice: on all years mixed, and trained before 2024 and tested on 2024 onward.
4. Sorted negative reviews into themes with word lists, followed the themes by year and quarter, and matched reviews to app releases.
5. Found 4 and 5 star reviews whose text reads negative, and drew recent reviews in a 3D chart of date, text score and length.

## Results

- The model labels 96% of reviews correctly and catches 90% of complaints; trained on older reviews, it still gets 95% and 89% on recent ones.
- Pricing and subscription come up in 40% of negative reviews, ahead of features and changes (28%) and payments (18%).
- Payments led complaints in 2018; pricing has led every year since 2019.
- The least liked releases came out in May and June 2019, with 53% to 67% negative reviews, mostly about pricing.
- 93 reviews with 4 or 5 stars read negative, which star averages miss.

## Tools

Python, pandas, scikit-learn, matplotlib, plotly
